title: Error counts per service from a JSON-lines log

turns.prompt: {D}/app.log is a JSON-lines log (fields ts, service, level, msg). Count the lines with level "error" per service and write {D}/errors.csv with header service,errors sorted by service name. Then tell me the counts.
turns.verify: f={D}/errors.csv; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no errors.csv; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f; echo PASS
